newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee ends down on dlr short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee ends down on dlr short-covering.

text.p: COLOMBO, Dec 12 - The Sri Lanka rupee closed down on Thursday on demand for dollars, which was fuelled by import covering and speculation, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 56.80 to the dollar, after opening at 56.70. The rupee closed at 56.68 on Wednesday.
"The rupee slipped on commercial-driven demand, which was backed by speculation," said a Standard Chartered Bank dealer.
The upside, however, was capped at 56.83 as sellers emerged, he said.
